title: Dataq Twinverse — Architecture & Trust
seo_title: Dataq Twinverse — Architecture & Trust | Dataq Software
meta_description: Architecture, security posture and compliance evidence for Dataq Twinverse — Digital Twin & IoT Intelligence Platform from Dataq Software.

blocks.x: The Dataq Software build of Dataq Twinverse — Architecture & Trust: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (retrofit telemetry with data contracts, physics+data models with validation regime, KubeEdge-class orchestration with OTA); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (RUL models into CMMS scheduling, what-if and capacity simulation); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.
